item.title: Report: White Sox owner-in-waiting's private equity firm set to purchase South Loop land that could be home to new ballpark
item.description: Crain's Chicago Business reports that White Sox owner-in-waiting Justin Ishbia's private equity firm, Chicago-based Shore Capital, is close to a deal to purchase a 47-acre rail yard from Amtrak, the 14th Street Coach Yard, that's near the southwest corner of the Loop and across the river from the 62-acre development site known as "The 78."

item.title: Ford Motor Company's longest tenured employee shares his secret to longevity
item.description: Jim Lee, Richard Laumeyer, and Arthur Porter are three of the longest-tenured employees at Ford's Chicago Stamping Plant, with a combined 195 years of service, and have adapted to the changing automation of the factory over the decades.

item.title: Funeral arrangements announced for Chicago firefighter Michael Altman
item.description: Funeral arrangements have been announced for Chicago firefighter/EMT Michael Altman, who died while fighting a Monday morning fire on the city's North Side.

item.title: Last week's severe storms produce record-breaking 6.6 inch hailstone
item.description: DEKALB, Ill. (WGN) - Last week, strong storms across Chicagoland produced some mammoth hailstones. We saw them splashing in the Kankakee River and even crashing down on the highway, shattering as they hit the pavement. Some of the hail stones reside in a refrigerator at Davis Hall, a building on the Northern Illinois University campus [...]

item.title: College student from Chicago suburbs missing in Barcelona during spring break trip
item.description: James "Jimmy" Gracey, a 20-year-old University of Alabama student from Elmhurst, has been reported missing in Barcelona, Spain after going missing at a club on Barceloneta Beach.
